about: Reconstructed raid boss trials (inferred as a whole). The original raid bosses ran server AI scripts (NPCConfig _iAISpecial) that the client does not ship; their scripted mechanics are rebuilt from what the client does ship: the raid's tips (ChatConfig), the encounter guide (TenChallengeHandbookIDConfig), the mechanic's NPCs and buffs, and the scene editor's points. Each trial: a start (time after the boss engages, repeat, HP thresholds), tips, a window, the objects and colours it deals out, a rule judged when the window closes, and the outcomes. A failed rule costs a share of the maximum HP (never a wipe by itself); a solved one may reward and stagger the boss. Engine: DungeonService.RaidTrials.

contract.tips: 1022 SystemBoardCastMsgNtf {chatId}. A CombatCountdownTip (ChatConfig _iType 16) counts its ${1} down from param 1 in seconds (UI_Sys_GVE_MarqueeWidgetCtrl: m_fTargetTimestamp = params[1] + GetSystemTime()).
contract.colours: A note buff with _kUIParams [1, colour] shows the local player's note on the HUD (UI_Sys_Main_DungeonNoteWidgetBaseCtrl: Red 1, Yellow 2, Green 3, Blue 4).
contract.objects: Props are shown as their NPCConfig _iNPCType (1 monster unit, 2 NPC, 4 trigger, 10 bullet), like the scripted scenes' actors and the field MVPs' ground objects; destructible ones are monsters outside the room's counted actors.
contract.hits: A failed trial's hit is the boss's 31101 of the named skill with a share of each player's maximum HP (inferred).

isti.name: Isti (Realm of the Gods 3020101)
evidence: ChatConfig 4110011 (type 12): 'Isti invites you to perform an Ocean Concerto! Quickly touch the bubble matching your note to gain a buff.'

TenChallengeHandbookIDConfig 1100105 Ocean Concerto: every player gets a note, many bubbles move toward the centre; a bubble touching a player with the matching note disappears and gives that player a damage buff, one reaching the Crystal Orb explodes.

BuffConfig 14720201/14720501/14720601/14720701: the Red/Yellow/Blue/Green note (_kUIParams [1,1]/[1,2]/[1,4]/[1,3], the HUD note widget), 14720301 Bubble Movement (+5% damage per stack, 30 stacks, 30 s).

NPCConfig 14720013-14720016: 'P@{1} Red/Yellow/Blue/Green Bubble NPC' (the second phase's bubbles); boss skill 14724101 'P@{1} Action', a 40 s channel whose show is the ground flow, water balls and note tails.

Scene editor sc_pm_shirenben_001_dg01: groups 17 'P2 bubble points 45 degrees' and 34 'P2 bubble points 22.5 degrees', 16 points on a ring of about 28 m around the BOSS point 93; BGM BGM_S1Ten_Boss1_P1 and _P2 (two phases).
guessed: The concerto is the second phase: it starts when Isti falls to 60% HP and comes back every 70 s.
The moving bubbles stand still, 45% of the way in from the ring toward Isti, two per player (4 to 16); each takes the colour of a note someone holds.
The window is 25 s; every bubble left then reaches the orb and costs everyone 10% of their maximum HP (at most 50%), shown as Full-Arena Wave 14721101.
Other first-phase patterns (Bubble Dream, colliding bubbles, Underwater Fireworks) are left to the boss's own skills.

evidence: ChatConfig 4618 'Ta-da! It's time for your test!', 4611 (CombatCountdownTip, 15 s) 'Reach your performance position within ${1} seconds', 4616 'Wonderful... Finally, someone who can keep up with my steps...', 4615 'Too slow! Go practice and come back later...'.

NPCConfig 14740002 'Circle-Stepping Magic Circle' (type 4, interaction distance 2 m); scene editor sc_pm_shirenben_001_dg02 points 601-623 'circle creation points' on a 10 m grid in front of the boss.
BuffConfig 14742501 Perfect State (+30% movement speed, +30% damage, 30 s), the reward of a correct dance step; skill 14744200 'Dance Machine_New' (14.66 s), skill 14740500 Dazzling Dance Step.
BGM Boss2_Dance: a separate dance phase.

The four-direction step copying (Dance Move skills, rhythm buttons) is not reproduced: reaching the circle is the test.

ilmo.name: Ilmo (Realm of the Gods 3020103)
evidence: TenChallengeHandbookIDConfig 1100301 Beat Prison: Ilmo keeps beating a drum to charge an ultimate; several areas appear, players collect the notes shown above the areas and enter the areas to raise a damage immunity barrier.
ChatConfig 4606 (CombatCountdownTip, 30 s) 'Enter the circles in order to compose the melody. ${1} seconds remaining', 4603 'The drumbeat will explode in ${1} seconds' (30 s).

NPCConfig 14760001-14760004 'Collect Red/Blue/Yellow/Green Note' at scene points 17-20 (NpcLevelPointRespawnConfig 14760000-14760003), interactions 33-36 casting 'Obtain Red/Blue/Yellow/Green Note' 14772000-14772300; BuffConfig 14760001/14760101/14760201/14760301 Red/Blue/Yellow/Green Note (_kUIParams [1,1]/[1,4]/[1,2]/[1,3]).
NPCConfig 14760005-14760008: the coloured circles (born buffs 14760501-14760801 Red/Blue/Yellow/Green Note and a ring).
DungeonLua_3020103 numbylevel {1:2, 2:3, 3:5, 4:6, 5:8, 6:4} and npcidbyregion tables naming the 5 x 5 m regions of the editor's groups 34 (24, 27), 61 (28, 29, 66), 71 (72-75), 48 (49-54).

Skills 14769000-14769300 Drumbeat Cage (36.6 s, _kDamageParamExtra [2,100000,101,3]: all of the maximum HP), BuffConfig 14761401 Green Energy Barrier, 14761601-14761901 four 'Lock Life at X%' buffs (four phase gates).
guessed: Beat Prison comes at 80, 60, 40 and 20% HP (the four Lock Life gates), with 2, 3, 4 and 6 circles (groups 34, 61, 71, 48), each of a random colour.

A circle is lit by a player carrying its note stepping into it (2.5 m); the order is not enforced. All lit within 30 s: Green Energy Barrier on everyone and no damage; otherwise the cage costs everyone 50% of their maximum HP (not the data's 100%: no instant wipe).
The note pickups stand at points 17-20 during the trial (their own respawn rows; the editor puts the blue one on 18-20 by mistake).

mirko-normal.name: Mirko, Normal (Realm of the Gods 3020108)
evidence: ChatConfig 4620/4621/4622 (CombatCountdownTip, 30 s) 'Activate three/four/two Safe Zones simultaneously. ${1} seconds until the beat explodes'; skill 14783601 'Mechanic Starts' (35 s, 9 999 999 damage) and 14782101 'Party-Wipe Mechanic'.

NPCConfig 14780006, the zone marker (born buffs 14789001/14789101), placed by NpcLevelPointRespawnConfig at points 118-120 for 3020108 (three zones) and at the corner points 25-28 for 3020104 (four zones).

ChatConfig 4607 'Players with the corresponding notes must Kill the matching Musical Instrument'; TenChallengeHandbookIDConfig 1100403 Summon Musical Instrument: Harp and Trumpet of different colours, players with the matching colour must destroy them.

NPCConfig 14780014/14780015 Golden Horn and Blue Harp (level 57, a 20 s timer buff 14789901/14789801); DungeonLua_3020108 buffid {1:147600, 2:147880, 3:147603, 4:147881}: BuffConfig 14788001 (gold note, _kUIParams [1,2]) and 14788101 (blue note, [1,4]); skills 14783501/14783801 Musical Instrument Full-Field AOE.
Scene editor sc_pm_shirenben_001_dg04 group 18: points 101-104 on the four edges, 16 m from the boss.
guessed: Safe zones: 40 s into the fight and every 80 s Mirko holds for 30 s playing Mechanic Starts; every zone needs a player standing in it (3 m) at the end, else the beat costs everyone 50% of their maximum HP. Fewer players than zones: as many zones as players (a lone tester gets one, with the two-zone line).

Instruments: 75 s into the fight and every 80 s, every player gets a gold or blue note and one instrument per player (two to four) stands at the edge points; only a player of its colour damages it, 4 hits per player destroy it; each one left after 20 s costs everyone 20% (at most 60%) as the full-field AOE.
Compose and Perform Movement (the recorded 4-note scores of DungeonLua music/skill) are not reproduced; the recordable skills stay in the boss's own rotation.

orc-hero.name: Orc Hero (five-player raid, Orc Village 3120101)
evidence: ChatConfig 4311 (CombatCountdownTip, 15 s) 'Orc Hero will unleash its ultimate skill in ${1} seconds. Pick up the Giant Blade and interrupt Orc Hero's charging!', 4314403 'Pick up the giant blade!!!', 4314404 'Use the skill granted by the giant blade while facing Orc Hero!', 4314405 'Orc Hero dropped his shield! Hurry and pick it up!', 4314406 'Use the shield to block the giant blade launched by Orc Hero!'.

TenChallengeHandbookIDConfig 1050202 Lost Giant Blade (pick up the blade, use Giant Blade Slash to interrupt the full-screen charge) and 1050203 Giant-Blade Kunai (blades at several players, massive damage to those without the specified status; shields block them).

NPCConfig 43100002 (type 4, unit 40053 'the giant blade dropped in the five-player raid') and 43100004 (type 4, unit 40054 'the dropped shield'); skills 4311501 Raise Shield Start (15 s show), 4311701 Broken While Raising Shield, 4311801 Full-screen AOE, 4312501 Launch Blade (second hit 10 000 000), 4314401 Obtain Greatblade, 4314501 Obtain Shield.
BuffConfig 4310401 'Blade Mountain-Greatsword' (10 s, 'face the boss and use the skill'), 4310601 Shield (30 s, -50% movement speed, blocks the flying blades), 4311601 the weapon deflection callout.
Scene editor sc_pm_pve5orchero_001_dg01: mark points 18-25 in a ring of 18-20 m around the boss point 31.
guessed: Lost Giant Blade 30 s into the fight and every 70 s: Orc Hero holds his raised shield (4311501) for 15 s while the blade lies at a random ring point. Walking onto it picks it up (the blade's derived skill 4313601 is not handed out: the client's derived-skill slot is filled by the skill wheel sync); the carrier's next hit on Orc Hero breaks the shield: he staggers 3 s (4311701). Otherwise the full-screen AOE costs everyone 50%.

Giant-Blade Kunai 55 s in and every 70 s: the shield lies at his feet, two players (fewer when fewer fight) are marked; after 12 s each marked player without a shield carrier within 3 m (themselves included) takes 60% as Launch Blade.
